review_text: I'm very disappointed. I forgot my eSewa password and tried to reset but they did not send the code because of security issues. And messaging continuously to reset my password because someone was trying to reset it.

author: Mahesh Magar
review_text: Update: They have fixed the issue I came through with and I'm satisfied with their service. I felt they've become more responsive now. Would be better if they soon add other means of remittance apart from 'eSewa Remit'. Furthermore I would request to get in touch with more colleges/schools for fee payment.
